group_reduction: maximum cosine similarity; normalize both image and text features
interpretation: suspected no-target proxy; not noise probability or confirmed wrong label
development_basis: 28 training cases checked before freeze: 18 non-appearance-content examples and 10 protected appearance examples. At 0.05, 15/18 positives selected and 0/10 protected selected. These are deliberately selected development cases, not accuracy estimates.
known_misses: Three text-only development cases below margin 0.05 retained. No quota is imposed.
validation_access: only after independent acceptance passes; same frozen rule, no adjustment from validation outcomes
formal_training: not started in detector acceptance stage; reuse existing global/local mask adapter after a passed checkpoint
